stem: A payments startup's auditor is preparing a PCI DSS assessment and has asked the security team to provide AWS's own current SOC 2 Type II report as evidence of the controls AWS operates under the shared responsibility model. Which action fulfills this request with the least effort?

choices.text: Download the report from the AWS Artifact console
Export AWS Config findings for the in-scope Regions
Open a support case asking AWS for the report
Generate a summary of the account's IAM Access Analyzer findings

rationale: AWS Artifact gives on-demand, no-cost downloads of AWS's own compliance reports, including SOC reports, which is exactly the evidence of AWS's side of the shared responsibility model that this auditor is asking for. AWS Config findings describe how the startup's own resources are configured, not what AWS itself operates, so they answer a different question. Opening a support case adds a manual round trip for a report that is already available on demand in Artifact. IAM Access Analyzer findings describe the account's own resource access, which again documents the customer's responsibility, not AWS's.
